spellbook.finance/limitations: This changes public eBay behavior for the whole workspace. It is not a preview, and nothing asks the seller again before SpellBook acts on the new mode.
Only the workspace owner may call it. An admin or member gets delegated_agent_workspace_owner_required.
Set a mode only after the seller chose it in their own words. Never pick one for them, and never read silence as a choice. New workspaces start on manual.
The response is the saved setting. Call spellbook_store_setup_status afterwards and tell the seller ebayAutomation.meaning in plain words.

auto_list and full answer 409 ebay_setup_incomplete until eBay setup has finished, the same check the web app makes before it offers them. The reason names each unfinished step and the SpellBook page where the seller finishes it. Nothing is saved on a 409.

auto_list and full answer agent_marketplace_publish_disabled while SpellBook has agent marketplace writes switched off, the switch that also governs spellbook_ebay_publish. manual always saves, so an agent can always turn eBay automation off. Switching agent marketplace writes off later also stops an auto_list or full an agent set earlier: SpellBook treats it as manual until the switch is back on or the seller picks a mode in the web app.
auto_list and full list nothing without a saved eBay pricing strategy.
Setting full also starts a pass that sorts the workspace's eBay inventory into per-set listings.

basicLandsEnabled false stops new automatic single listings of basic lands, but a basic land single listing that is already live stays live. It also drops basic lands from per-set listings, so a per-set listing that holds only basic lands ends. An explicit spellbook_ebay_publish still lists a basic land.
basicLandsEnabled true answers agent_marketplace_publish_disabled while agent marketplace writes are switched off. false always saves.

description: Set one workspace's eBay automation mode, which decides whether SpellBook lists and reprices on eBay by itself, and whether that automation lists basic lands. This changes public eBay behavior for the workspace, only the workspace owner may call it, and the agent sets a mode only after the seller chose one. The modes: manual: Nothing lists or reprices on eBay automatically; you publish from the eBay preview when you choose. auto_list: New eligible inventory lists on eBay automatically at your saved eBay pricing strategy's prices, and existing eBay listings are never repriced automatically. full: New inventory lists on eBay automatically, and existing eBay listings reprice from your saved eBay pricing strategy. With variation packages on (the default), new inventory groups into one listing per set with each card as a variation; with them off, each card lists on its own.

basicLandsEnabled.description: true lets auto_list and full list basic lands (Plains, Island, Swamp, Mountain, Forest, Wastes, and their Snow-Covered printings). false skips them. The saved value defaults to false.

mode.description: The mode the seller chose: manual, auto_list, or full. Send mode, basicLandsEnabled, or both.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose eBay automation mode to set. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_automation_set
